facts.text: Empire State University allows students to document their verifiable learning from life or work experience through Individualized Credit for Prior Learning, which is evaluated by expert assessors.

sources.title: Individualized Credit for Prior Learning (iCPL)
sources.quote: Individualized Credit for Prior Learning (iCPL) is the process by which students explain and document their college-level learning, which is then assessed by an expert evaluator.
